parameters.query: SELECT ct.id, ct.title, ct.municipality, ct.state, ct.organization_id, o.name as org_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cf.id) as files_count, MAX(cte.event_date) as last_update FROM chat_threads ct LEFT JOIN organizations o ON ct.organization_id = o.id LEFT JOIN chat_files cf ON ct.id = cf.thread_id LEFT JOIN chat_timeline_events cte ON ct.id = cte.thread_id {{ $json.where_clause }} GROUP BY ct.id, ct.title, ct.municipality, ct.state, ct.organization_id, o.name ORDER BY last_update DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT {{ $json.limit }} OFFSET {{ $json.offset }}
SELECT id FROM chat_files WHERE thread_id = {{ $json.thread_id }} ORDER BY uploaded_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orgs FROM organizations WHERE is_active = true
SELECT org_id, COUNT(*) as connection_count FROM org_connections WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY org_id
